name: GPS spoofing → navigation integrity failure
description: In contested airspace a nation-state actor spoofs GNSS; the UAV deviates from course (mission steps 4, 8, 9, 10, 16).
lossEvent: Mission abort, or loss or capture of the aircraft

name: Supply-chain malware / false data injection
description: Software supply-chain compromise leads to flight-control or telemetry data poisoning (C2 or flight-control software).
lossEvent: Loss of control, crash, or incorrect refueling

name: C2 link jamming / outage
description: LOS and BLOS C2 jammed in contested airspace; the UAV executes its lost-link procedure.
lossEvent: Mission abort (lost refueling sorties) rather than aircraft destruction
